correctness.rationale: Work in the universal six-point blow-up basis, write P for the matrix of the 27 line classes and D=diag(1,−1,…,−1) for the intersection form. The meeting adjacency is A=I+PᵀDP since a line has self-intersection −1 and distinct lines have intersection 0 or 1. The residual conic in a plane through ℓ has class h−[ℓ]. Each other line meeting ℓ lies in its unique such plane and occurs in the residual conic. A doubled line or a residual conic containing ℓ would require h=ℓ+2m or h=2ℓ+m, impossible on intersecting the repeated line, which has h-degree one and self-intersection −1. Thus the ten neighbors are paired into the five conic fibers even at special incidences. Independently of the common-neighbor computation, the given classes give PPᵀD(x)=5h(h·x)−6x: summing the class terms on H yields 39H−15ΣE_i, and on E_i gives 15H−11E_i−5Σ_{j≠i}E_j. Hence PA(v)=5(h Σa_ℓ−P(v)), and the h-degree gives column sums 10. Sylvester's determinant identity gives det A=det(I+PPᵀD)=10(−5)^6 because h²=3 and h-perpendicular has dimension six. Each column therefore satisfies both congruences, and their kernel has index 2·5^7: the Picard component is surjective by the E_i and H=L_12+E_1+E_2, while 5e_ℓ independently generates the parity component. Equal indices prove the exact image equality. The cokernel and Smith factors follow, and a line class has h-degree 1, so its mod-five class has order five and its formal parity has order two. Its order is exactly ten.
residual_risks: The free lattice is on geometric line symbols with integral coefficients. The quotient is not Picard torsion, and the argument does not assert a Galois-descent statement.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The idempotent modulo 5 has rank 20 by its reduced characteristic polynomial, and v5(det A)=7; therefore all seven positive 5-exponents are one. At 2 the determinant valuation is one. This mechanically gives the numerical Smith form, so that is credited as an implication, regardless of whether it is separately tabulated. Knowing the abstract quotient does not identify its congruence homomorphisms on the line symbols. The record uses a separate geometric argument: the actual generators map to 5(h−[ℓ]), parity vanishes, and the two conditions are independently surjective. The inspected tritangent/double-six and Steiner image statements do not give these generator classes or the resulting full-rank kernel for this support map.

originality.rationale: The five-fiber geometry and meeting graph are classical. The numerical index and abstract Smith type are immediate consequences of the published graph parameters and spectrum with the standard adjacency equation, and are not independent novelty. The supported distinct contribution is identifying the image intrinsically inside the formal line lattice by the two named congruences, i.e. identifying the quotient map itself rather than its abstract invariant factors. The closest graph and support statements inspected do not make that Picard identification for this map.
residual_risks: Earlier graph computations may tabulate the abstract numerical invariant, which is already credited as mechanically implied. Earlier work using the cubic Picard realization may contain the exact congruence kernel; bounded source comparison does not establish historical uniqueness. DistanceRegular timed out and was not read.

value.rationale: The geometrically specified support family is canonical, and the result decides whether an arbitrary prescribed formal combination of the 27 lines can be made integrally from it using parity and a coordinate-free Picard condition. This identifies which combinations fail, not just the known order and abstract shape of the obstruction. It gives an integral reconstruction test on the actual line generators that a graph spectrum, numerical Smith form, or rational solution cannot give by itself. The value is in this image identification, not the numerical diagonal or the classical conic geometry.
residual_risks: The calculation is universal across smooth cubic surfaces in the stated scope and does not encode variation in moduli.
